entities.summary: Goongloen Gongma Batoo Tshering, DYG, DRT, DW, DT, DK, is the current Chief Operations Officer of the Royal Bhutan Army (COO). He succeeded the outgoing chief, Goongloen Gongma Lam Dorji on 1 November 2005.
